analysis.insight_summary: Users experience problems with the latest version of [product_name] ([version_no]) and seek access to older stable releases. The lack of official options to obtain previous software versions leads to user frustration and drives them to look for unofficial sources. Community members occasionally share alternative links but comprehensive official support is missing.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate easy access to previous stable releases of the software to resolve issues when a newer version does not meet their needs.
pain_keywords: no official access to old versions
